aboutMe.intro: I'm a frontend engineer focused on the interface layer: component systems, performance, accessibility, and the details that make a product feel finished. I work mostly with React, Next.js, and TypeScript, closely with product and design.
aboutMe.experience: I started in 2010 writing COBOL for banking systems at ICBC and BBVA, software that couldn't go down. That still shapes how I build for the web: I think about edge cases, failure states, and what happens in production, not just in the demo.
aboutMe.passion: Since 2021 I've worked fully remote on production products: youth sports league discovery for RCX Sports, high-fidelity app clones for REAL Evals, featured by The New York Times, and AI creation tools at Magic Hour.
aboutMe.featuredContext: REAL Evals was featured by The New York Times; I contributed frontend engineering to the project.

projects.subtitle: A selection of my work, including projects featured in The New York Times

realevalsgmail.title: Gmail Clone - REAL Evals
realevalsgmail.description: Gmail clone I built for REAL Evals, where AI agents are evaluated against realistic apps. It covers email management, compose, labels, folders and search.

realevalsdashdish.title: DoorDash Clone - REAL Evals
realevalsdashdish.description: DoorDash clone I built for REAL Evals. It covers restaurant browsing, menus, cart and checkout.

realevalsuber.title: Uber Clone - REAL Evals
realevalsuber.description: Uber clone I built for REAL Evals. It covers map integration, route calculation, price estimates and a simulated driver match.

realevalsunited.title: United Airlines Clone - REAL Evals
realevalsunited.description: United Airlines clone I built for REAL Evals. It covers flight search, seat selection, booking and trip management through multi-step forms.

magichour.title: Magic Hour — AI Creation Tools
magichour.description: I built frontend features for Magic Hour's AI image and video generation and editing tools. The work included connecting generation jobs, asset validation, error handling and backend APIs in the Next.js app.

nbaleaguefinder.description: Jr. NBA/WNBA league finder: families search local youth basketball programs and seasons by location and continue to registration.

nhlleaguefinder.description: NHL Street league finder: families search local youth street hockey programs and seasons by location and continue to registration.

mlsleaguefinder.title: MLS League Finder - RCX Sports
mlsleaguefinder.description: MLS GO league finder: families search local youth soccer programs and seasons by location and continue to registration.

factupro.title: FactuPro - Invoice Management
factupro.description: Invoice and billing app for small businesses. I built invoice generation, payment tracking, client management and automated reminders.

real-evals.title: REAL Evals
real-evals.lead: High-fidelity app clones built for AI evaluation, featured in The New York Times.

rcx-sports.title: RCX Sports
rcx-sports.lead: Youth league finders for NFL FLAG, Jr. NBA/WNBA, NHL Street and MLS GO.

leagueFinders.title: RCX Sports League Finders
leagueFinders.description: One league finder for each of NFL FLAG, Jr. NBA/WNBA, NHL Street and MLS GO, built with Next.js and Chakra UI. Families search youth programs and seasons near them on a map and continue to registration.

frontendBonzzu.notes: Delivering scalable React/Next.js applications for Delos Company and RCX Sports, including RCX's public League Finder and the League Central operator platform. Designed reusable component systems using Material UI, Chakra UI, and Shadcn UI. Led performance optimizations through SSR, code splitting, and rendering efficiency improvements.

fullstackFreelance.notes: Delivered solutions for international clients including Vrio, Wpromote, REAL Evals (featured by The New York Times), and FactuPro. Currently building frontend features for Magic Hour's AI image and video creation tools with Next.js, React, and TypeScript. Specialized in SSR, performance optimization, and scalable component architectures.

fullstackNisum.notes: Delivered and maintained React/Redux interfaces for Science37's clinical research platform using JavaScript and TypeScript. Developed reusable UI components with Storybook and partnered with distributed teams across multiple time zones in remote Agile environments.

mainframeICBC.company: ICBC (Industrial and Commercial Bank of China)
mainframeICBC.notes: Led Anti-Money Laundering initiatives including impact analysis and effort estimation. Developed and maintained COBOL applications in batch and online (CICS) environments with DB2, MQ messaging, and VSAM/QSAM files. Managed production incidents ensuring system stability under strict SLAs.

cobolDeveloper.notes: Developed COBOL components for financial and high-volume batch systems across multiple banking institutions. Performed requirements analysis, system enhancements, and technical design. Leveraged DB2, MQ, JCL, and CICS for enterprise data processing in mission-critical environments.

frontendConstellation.notes: Built customer-facing web applications for enterprise clients using React and TypeScript. Collaborated with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality features on schedule.

softwareQuintica.notes: Developed full-stack web applications using modern JavaScript frameworks. Participated in all phases of software development lifecycle.
